queue_stages: Project initiation (Delivery Point Exchange submission, viability screen, queue placement)
Project feasibility (system studies, constructible solution, zoning confirmation, preliminary engineering)
Project development (detailed engineering, permitting, regulatory approvals)
facts.queue_size: About 70 GW of large-load delivery points; about 25 GW with projected connection dates through 2031; about 45 GW under study

warnings_if.text: Above Dominion's 300 MW per-request cap: the campus needs multiple requests or phases

lag.note: Stages 3-4 follow the zoning confirmation required in stage 2

duration.note: Northern Virginia wait for a 100 MW connection reported at about seven years (JLL 2026); Dominion substation-service queue reported beyond 36 months. P50 set below the headline, P90 at it.
